name: grand-aurelia-hotel-booking
description: The Grand Aurelia - Luxury Hotel Room Booking Web Application (MongoDB, Node.js, TypeScript, Skeuomorphic Luxury UX)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
